text:
Favorite part? That's like asking Picasso which brushstroke he liked best. But fine, I'll play.

It's the flying. Obviously. You strap yourself into a few hundred pounds of gold-titanium alloy that *you* built, in a cave, with a box of scraps, and then you punch through the sound barrier over the Pacific with AC/DC playing in your helmet. Nothing compares to that. Not the cars, not the parties, not even the cover of Time, and I've been on it. Several times. I have them framed.

But if you want the real answer, the one I don't put on the press release: it's that I finally get to clean up my own mess. For years my name was stamped on weapons that ended up in the wrong hands. Now my name's on something that actually protects people. Turns out that feels better than a billion-dollar defense contract. Don't tell my accountants.

Also, the suit has a minibar. Next question.
